messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Users cannot upload supplier invoices because the system rejects specific file formats. This blocks the claims process and prevents valid documents from being processed.",
 "similar": [
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4127",
   "similarity": 0.109,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-10-06T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Users can now upload multiple documents at once to a claim in Keelwater, streamlining the process and reducing manual effort for claims handlers.\", \"id\": 4127, \"name\": \"Bulk upload documents to a claim\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4128",
   "similarity": 0.057,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater now allows users to filter claims by date range, status, and claim type, making it easier to locate specific claims without scrolling through unrelated entries.\", \"id\": 4128, \"name\": \"Claim search refinements\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4129",
   "similarity": 0.056,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": true, \"completed_at\": \"2026-09-15T00:00:00Z\", \"description\": \"Keelwater automatically pulls and updates supplier contact details from integrated systems, ensuring claims handlers always have the most current information without manual entry.\", \"id\": 4129, \"name\": \"Supplier contact details\", \"started\": true, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 3}"
  },
  {
   "source": "shortcut",
   "id": "4133",
   "similarity": 0.054,
   "record": "{\"blocked\": false, \"completed\": false, \"completed_at\": null, \"description\": \"Keelwater's document classifier confidence threshold setting allows users to define the minimum confidence level required for automatic categorization of claims documents, ensuring only high-certainty classifications are applied without manual review.\", \"id\": 4133, \"name\": \"Document classifier confidence threshold\", \"started\": false, \"story_type\": \"feature\", \"workflow_state_id\": 1}"
  },
  {
   "source": "notion",
   "id": "4f3af2fd-e874-528b-a6f7-1719625085d3",
   "similarity": 0.051,
   "record": "{\"id\": \"4f3af2fd-e874-528b-a6f7-1719625085d3\", \"object\": \"page\", \"properties\": {\"Name\": {\"title\": [{\"plain_text\": \"Claims timeline\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"Claims timeline\"}, \"type\": \"text\"}], \"type\": \"title\"}, \"Problem\": {\"rich_text\": [{\"plain_text\": \"Keelwater's Claims timeline provides a clear, chronological view of each claim's progress, helping users track key events, decisions, and deadlines from submission through resolution.\", \"text\": {\"content\": \"Keelwater's Claims timeline provides a clear, chronological view of each claim's progress, helping users track key events, decisions, and deadlines from submission through resolution.\"}, \"type\": \"text\"}], \"type\": \"rich_text\"}, \"Status\": {\"sta"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is that supplier invoice uploads are rejected due to unsupported file formats, blocking claims processing. I checked the five most similar items: story 4127 (bulk upload, completed) addresses multi-document upload, not format rejection; 4128 (claim search) and 4129 (supplier contacts) are unrelated; 4133 (classifier confidence threshold, unstarted) does not address file format support; and the Claims timeline roadmap page is unrelated. No completed story or roadmap item covers the file-format rejection problem, so it remains open.", "verdict": "pass"}
